about: The Workbench icons of the LiquidWar drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/liquidwar.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a blue and a red liquid army meeting in a maze) is The AmiCradle Team's own, GPL-2 or later like the game; art/liquidwar.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. LiquidWar-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, LiquidWar.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-LiquidWar and COPYING.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
